# a comment terraform { required_version = ">= 1.5.0" required_providers { aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 5.0" } } } provider "aws" { region = var.region } variable "region" { type = string default = "eu-west-3" } variable "count_of" { type = number default = 3 } locals { name = "app-${var.region}" escaped = "a literal $${not_interpolated} brace" tags = { Owner = "team", Env = "prod" } slug = "${replace(local.name, "/[^a-z0-9]+/", "-")}" from = "${data.aws_ami.latest.id}" always = "${true}" mixed = "${var.count_of > 1 && false ? "many" : "one"}" } resource "aws_instance" "web" { count = var.count_of ami = data.aws_ami.latest.id instance_type = "t3.micro" tags = merge(local.tags, { Name = "${local.name}-${count.index + 1}" }) user_data = <<-EOT #!/bin/sh echo "${local.name}" > /tmp/name EOT } data "aws_ami" "latest" { most_recent = true owners = ["amazon"] filter { name = "name" values = ["al2023-ami-*"] } } output "public_ip" { value = aws_instance.web[0].public_ip sensitive = false }
